title: Wall Mount Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass | Antique Pewter | Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with a wall mount retractable hooks and garment rod that pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when not needed in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Holds up to 15 lb for coats, robes, or towels
- Customizable look: remove the included knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Wall-mounted design helps keep modern bathroom hardware organized without using floor space

Specs & installation:
- Category: Retractable hooks and garment rods
- Mounting: Wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Hardware: 6/32 toggles; mounting hardware included
- Drilling required: one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; projection 1"
- Product weight: 1 lb
available in multiple designer finish options including statement colors
